# Inference Pipeline

This document describes the current inference path after the transformer split.
It is a code map and execution overview, not a line-by-line math tutorial.

## High-Level Flow

```text
prompt text
  -> tokenizer
  -> optional batch prefill
  -> per-token transformer forward
  -> logits
  -> sampler
  -> decoded token text
```

Public entry points are in `include/generate.h` and `include/transformer.h`.
The CLI wiring is in `src/main.c`; the library orchestration is in
`src/generate.c`.

reference_capture.same_process_repeats: All overlapping same-profile heads agree, including pairs of96-output batches.
reference_capture.timings: All timings in this phase are diagnostic and excluded from performance acceptance; the initialization ledger adds host overhead.

product_correctness.acceptance: All248320 BF16 vocabulary words after exact F32 expansion, prompt/history IDs, finite values and generated tokens must match. No tolerance changes.

diagnosis.proven: Separate live autotuner instances can share the same generated kernel filename and disk cache key while retaining different selected launch configurations. A saved best_config is not a per-layer runtime contract.

live_init_profile.derivation: Actual selected config and PTX, exact named-parameter pointers, original generated sources; no output fitting.

diagnosis.earlier_profileB: The old three-head difference is reproducible without hidden readbacks and persists from decode index61 through95 for request0, at fixed logical geometry. Its complete live per-instance initialization trace was not captured; do not retrospectively assign it a guessed policy or claim its exact layer choice is proven.

failed_candidate.reason: One shared saved cache choice was over-applied to three source-identical layer instances; rejected.

observer_failure.reason: Optional original Python function metadata can be absent after AOT reconstruction.
observer_failure.correction: Guard optional metadata; original failed attempt remains preserved; corrected reference run passes.

reproduce.placement: Copy producer to /evidence/reference.py and observer to /evidence/sitecustomize.py; include /evidence in PYTHONPATH before starting every original worker. The actual pinned Docker command and private cache are in reference-init-ledger/command.json and vllm-cache.
reproduce.required_metadata: Record live per-instance normalization choices during initialization/capture and actual prefill; bind pointer identities to named parameters from that worker; preserve selected PTX. Validate complete heads against an unobserved-token control.

limitations: Only the declared checkpoint, GPU and workloads are qualified. A profile is a pinned arithmetic contract, not universal bit identity across autotuning choices.
ProfileB remains an explicitly unqualified original profile; all its raw values are preserved.
The observed initialization-ledger profile has correctness qualification, not new performance or sustained-SLO qualification.
All-family resident/offload performance, diverse working sets, transfer/stall/physical setup peaks, broader CPU/Metal coverage and native cross-request shared GPU projection work remain open.
